activity.role: Persian epic poet completing an early form of the Shahnameh
activity.notes: Encyclopaedia Iranica reports the poet's own dated completion of the Shahnameh in 1010; possible subsequent revisions or presentation to Mahmud around 1018/1019 are a distinct, debated event. 1010 is a single representative work-completion year, not an assertion of final publication or the span of his career. Ghaznavid territorial context concerns the Tus/Khorasan region and is not a claim of direct Ghaznavid official appointment.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Ferdowsi, Life
sources.citation_text: A textual colophon in the Shahnameh dates the initial completion to 8 March 1010; the encyclopaedia separately discusses debate over later revision or transmission under Mahmud of Ghazna.
